Every command but daemon, observe, setting and update is served by the daemon; wdx daemon start runs it.

## Commands

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`wdx agent`](/wdx/docs/reference/cli/agent/) | Manage agents: AI coding agents that belong to a project and outlive the daemon |
| [`wdx completion`](/wdx/docs/reference/cli/completion/) | Print the script that completes wdx commands in a shell |
| [`wdx daemon`](/wdx/docs/reference/cli/daemon/) | Start, stop and inspect the daemon |
| [`wdx deps`](/wdx/docs/reference/cli/deps/) | Show and install the programs wdx needs besides itself |
| [`wdx doc`](/wdx/docs/reference/cli/doc/) | Manage docs: a project's text, kept by wdx outside its repository |
| [`wdx message`](/wdx/docs/reference/cli/message/) | See the messages still waiting to reach a terminal or agent |
| [`wdx observe`](/wdx/docs/reference/cli/observe/) | Run Grafana with the logs and metrics |
| [`wdx plan`](/wdx/docs/reference/cli/plan/) | Manage plans: the work of a feature broken into tasks for agents |
| [`wdx project`](/wdx/docs/reference/cli/project/) | Manage projects |
| [`wdx setting`](/wdx/docs/reference/cli/setting/) | Show and change the settings |
| [`wdx terminal`](/wdx/docs/reference/cli/terminal/) | Manage terminals: shells that belong to a project and outlive the daemon |
| [`wdx tide`](/wdx/docs/reference/cli/tide/) | Work in the terminal IDE: a project, an agent and terminals in one window |
| [`wdx update`](/wdx/docs/reference/cli/update/) | Show whether a newer wdx is released, install it or roll it back |
| [`wdx version`](/wdx/docs/reference/cli/version/) | Print the version of wdx and of the daemon |
| [`wdx worktree`](/wdx/docs/reference/cli/worktree/) | Read a project's worktrees, what is uncommitted and what a PR would show, land them and remove them |

## Flags every command takes

| Flag | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--color <mode>` | `auto` | color text output in this mode: auto, always or never |
| `-h, --help` |  | help for wdx |
| `--json` |  | print the result as one JSON object; never prompts |
| `--no-input` |  | never prompt; fail where a question would be asked |

## Exit codes

| Exit | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | ok |
| 1 | rejected: a conflict, not found or cancelled |
| 2 | usage: the command line or a setting is invalid |
| 3 | system: an unexpected failure |

Each command lists the error codes it can return; [Errors and exit codes](/wdx/docs/reference/errors/) lists them all. With `--json`, see [JSON output](/wdx/docs/reference/json/).
